characters.name: Jesus
characters.note: Central figure of the Gospel of John, the Son of God incarnate.

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.note: Prophet who baptized in the Jordan and testified about Jesus.

characters.name: God the Father
characters.note: God in heaven, Father of Jesus.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus, formerly of John.

characters.name: Simon Peter
characters.note: Disicple of Jesus, brother of Andrew.

characters.name: Philip
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus from Bethsaida.

characters.name: Nathanael
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus whom Jesus saw under the fig tree.

characters.name: Mary, mother of Jesus
characters.note: Mother of Jesus, present at Cana and the cross.

characters.name: Nicodemus
characters.note: Pharisee who came to Jesus by night and later helped bury him.

characters.name: Samaritan Woman
characters.note: Woman at Jacob's well whom Jesus spoke with.

characters.name: Nobleman
characters.note: Official whose son was healed by Jesus in Capernaum.

characters.name: Blind Man
characters.note: Man healed by Jesus at the pool of Siloam.

characters.name: Lazarus
characters.note: Brother of Martha and Mary, whom Jesus raised from the dead.

characters.name: Martha
characters.note: Sister of Lazarus and Mary.

characters.name: Mary of Bethany
characters.note: Sister of Lazarus and Martha, who anointed Jesus' feet.

characters.name: Judas Iscariot
aliases: Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot
characters.note: Disciple who betrayed Jesus.

characters.name: Thomas
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus.

characters.name: Malchus
characters.note: Servant whose ear Peter cut off.

characters.name: Annas
characters.note: Former high priest, father-in-law to Caiaphas.

characters.name: Caiaphas
characters.note: High priest that year.

characters.name: Pontius Pilate
characters.note: Roman governor who judged Jesus.

characters.name: Barabbas
characters.note: Robber released instead of Jesus.

characters.name: Mary Magdalene
characters.note: Follower of Jesus who found the empty tomb.

characters.name: The Beloved Disciple
characters.note: Author/tradition-bearer of the Gospel, close disciple of Jesus.

characters.name: Mary, wife of Clopas
characters.note: Present at the cross.

characters.name: Joseph of Arimathaea
characters.note: Secret disciple who buried Jesus.

characters.name: Pharisees
characters.note: Religious leaders opposed to Jesus.

characters.name: Disciples
characters.note: Followers of Jesus.

characters.name: Roman Soldiers
characters.note: Soldiers who guarded, mocked, and crucified Jesus.

characters.name: Crowd
characters.note: Crowds following Jesus or gathered at feasts.

characters.name: Angels
characters.note: Heavenly messengers at the tomb.

brief.era: Ancient Near East / First Century Roman Judea and Galilee
brief.place: Various locations across Judea, Samaria, Galilee, and Jerusalem, featuring ancient stone architecture, desert wilderness, lakesides, and temple complexes.
brief.dress: First-century Judean tunics, cloaks, sandals, and head coverings for locals; Roman military armor and helmets for soldiers.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Stone houses, synagogues, the monumental Second Temple in Jerusalem, wooden fishing boats, clay water pots, oil lamps, scrolls, crosses, and stone tombs.
depiction_rules: Jesus should be depicted as a humble first-century Jewish man with loving and authoritative presence.
Angels should appear bright or in white garments.
Miracles and divine epiphanies should be depicted with reverent, atmospheric lighting.
